records.finding: attribute_contributions and ability_multipliers exist in reward JSON but are not parsed into RewardProfile and therefore do not affect EquipmentScaler.
records.mechanism: BalanceDataParser.parseRewards constructs RewardProfile(item_id, source_boss, category); RewardProfile has exactly those three components; EquipmentScaler adds only Progression enchantment contributions.

records.finding: Frostbitten Golem special damage multipliers [2.7, 2.8, 3.2, 5.0, 5.0] stack with the ordinary registered-boss tier boost and hosted participant damage factor outside Raid; hosted owned attacks then receive x0.88. Raid skips the profile special multiplier.
records.mechanism: JemWorldBossTiers multiplies factor by BossTierScaling.boost(tier), then non-Raid specialDamageMultiplier, then HostedEncounters.damageFactor; a later hosted-owner branch multiplies by 0.88.

records.finding: Blood Moon Armor Penetration is post-mitigation damage amplification, not removal of a fraction of armor/toughness.
records.mechanism: LivingDamageEvent amount is divided by (1 - min(0.30, penetration)); the event is after armor mitigation. The player debuff is another damage multiplier.

records.finding: Tier III Progression chest guard is consumed by the first qualifying LivingHurtEvent while ready, without a heavy-hit, projectile, minimum-damage or damage-type gate of its own.
records.mechanism: The guardReady branch adds 35% reduction and immediately writes a 240-tick cooldown; it is independent of the separate heavy-hit branch.

records.finding: The current main branch does not grant artificial infinite durability or default max-damage values to progression/boss equipment. Eligible equipment keeps native wear, Mending and Unbreaking; dropped-item protection is a separate loss-prevention rule.
records.mechanism: Current module logic lock and localization explicitly preserve normal durability; no InfiniteEquipmentDurability production class exists in the current source tree.
